payload.authority_effect: Authorizes the 6529 Network Museum to acquire one original MAX PAIN by XCOPY for its permanent Collection through a collectively funded purchase, effective at the Wave decision time. Each affirmative voter commits an equal share of the final acquisition cost, to be sent to a designated acquisition wallet, and contributors receive no individual or fractional ownership interest in the acquired NFT. The acquisition remains subject to the Museum's ordinary procedures for provenance, title, authenticity, legal compliance, custody, technical receivability, and accession. The proposal names no exact token, price cap, budget, wallet, or treatment of excess contributions. This decision does not itself select a token, establish payment, title, custody, or rights, or accept, acquire, or accession any work or asset.
